title: On The Edge Of The Carpet

contact_edits.before: James Blendick's Harry, describing the terror in slow, honey- sweet tones, leaves no doubt of its reality; Patricia Collins' Edna breaks down in pitiable tears. At times, just as believably, he's Tobias' good country club buddy, and she's a strict-but-fair godmother, slapping Julia for her own good. And at others, they treat the place as if they own it and have a right to. It's very funny, in every sense. They come and go and return and leave. It's as if they've held a mirror up to Agnes and Tobias, and the image has been rejected. Tobias returns to apologizing, Agnes to meditating on madness, and they and their realtives to their matching solitudes. If it's possible for a play and a production to be both lucid and mysterious, that is the achievement here. - A Delicate Balance is in repertoire until September 28. For tickets, call 1-800-567-1600 or visit Stratfordfestival.ca.
